summary: This file contains several news articles from various sources like BBC, Gizmodo, NPR, and Business Insider, dated around October and November 2025. Topics range from the New York City mayoral election, technology trends (AI, social media), sports, and cultural events like Comic Con. The New York City mayoral election is a prominent theme, covering the candidates, their platforms, and the surprising victory of Zohran Mamdani. Other articles discuss Google's bug problem in NYC offices, cosplay at New York Comic Con, Keely Hodgkinson's 800m win in New York, and various tech and entertainment news.
keyPoints: Zohran Mamdani wins New York City mayoral election, becoming the youngest and first Muslim mayor.
Mamdani's campaign focused on affordability and cost-of-living issues.
Andrew Cuomo and Curtis Sliwa were also candidates in the NYC mayoral race.
New York City sues social media companies (Meta, Alphabet, Snap, ByteDance) over youth mental health crisis.
New York Comic Con 2025 showcased cosplay, film/TV news, comics, and toy reveals.
Keely Hodgkinson won the 800m race at the Athlos meet in New York.
Google's New York offices reportedly experienced a bed bug infestation.
AI and technology are influencing education, with more STEM students focusing on data analysis.
Hasbro revealed new Marvel and Star Wars figures at New York Comic Con 2025.
Marvel is developing a 'Wonder Man' series.
Anime adaptation of 'All You Need Is Kill' is in production.
A third 'Mortal Kombat' movie is being planned.
New York City's venture capitalists mostly supported Andrew Cuomo in the mayoral election.
Pharmacists are struggling with funding issues and potential pharmacy closures.
Lottery win for a Barrow family was prompted by daughter's sweets request.
'It: Welcome to Derry' creators aim for shock value in the opening scene.
A tale of two cities, London and New York, is discussed in relation to their Muslim mayors.
The impact of AI on high school STEM education is being observed.
The 'Daredevil: Born Again' series will connect to 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day'.
ChatGPT's browser bot seemingly avoids links from companies suing OpenAI, like The New York Times.
There are a mix of reactions to the 'Last Jedi' film in the Star Wars series.
plans: Mamdani's plans include free childcare, expanded public transportation, and government intervention in free market systems.
Mamdani plans to arrest Benjamin Netanyahu if he enters New York City.
Mamdani has plans to lower the cost of living in NYC.
events: Athlos meet in New York (Keely Hodgkinson's win)
